stories.title: Betsi Cadwaladr tops list of concerns raised with Healthcare Inspectorate Wales
stories.summary: North Wales’ health board had more concerns raised about it with the Welsh healthcare watchdog than any other NHS organisation in Wales in 2025-26. Healthcare Inspectorate Wales (HIW) received 115 concerns about Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board (BCUHB), ahead of 110 for Swansea Bay University Health Board, out of 783 in total. stories.title: Deestriders race at Arrowe Park and Trailfest half marathon
stories.summary: Deestriders runners raced on the Wirral and in the Trailfest half marathon in the week beginning 21 September. Paul Lewtey was the club’s first finisher in the fourth Arrowe Park multi-terrain race on Tuesday 22 September, in 27:27. stories.title: Deeside community gym creates outdoor exercise area for people put off by traditional gyms
stories.summary: A Deeside community gym has bought equipment for a new outdoor exercise area aimed at people who would rather not train in a conventional gym. stories.title: North Wales man jailed over £4m of machinery obtained on finance
stories.summary: A Prestatyn man has been jailed for five years after taking heavy plant machinery on finance and selling it abroad without repaying the loans.
